preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The string s has length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'UD' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in s is either 'U' or 'D'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers separated by spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in results)
postconditions.description: Each output value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all((results[i] == -1) or (results[i] >= 1) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 (infinite loop) or a positive integer representing the duration.

postconditions.expression: all((results[i] == -1) == (not terminates(i, s)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each starting step i, the result is -1 if and only if the simulation never moves beyond the stairs; otherwise it is the number of seconds until falling.

postconditions.expression: all((results[i] != -1) == (steps_until_fall(i, s) == results[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each starting step i where termination occurs, the result equals the exact number of steps taken until moving beyond the stairs (including the final fall step).
